title: Red Hat Security Advisory: .NET 8.0 security update
description: .NET 8.0 on Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.6 has received an important security update addressing two vulnerabilities: an out-of-bounds write in the Google Brotli decoder (CVE-2026-111497) and an elevation of privilege vulnerability in ASP.NET Core affecting multiple .NET versions (CVE-2026-114148). These issues could allow attackers to cause memory corruption or escalate privileges. Red Hat has released updated packages for these components as part of the 9.6 Extended Update Support. Users should apply the provided updates to mitigate these vulnerabilities.
